1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    35	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    36	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    37	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    38	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    39	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    40	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    41	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    42	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    43	#
    44	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    45	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    46	# =============================================================================
    47	set -euo pipefail
    48	export LC_ALL=C
    49	
    50	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    51	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    52	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    53	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    54	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    55	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
    56	
    57	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    58	die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    59	
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    63	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
    64	    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
    65	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    67	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    68	  esac
    69	done
    70	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    71	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    72	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    73	for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    74	# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
    75	pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
    76	# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    77	source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    78	popd >/dev/null
    79	
    80	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
    81	trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
    82	yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
    83	
    84	# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).

    99	    else
   100	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   101	    fi
   102	  done
   103	done
   104	
   105	# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;
   106	# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.
   107	python3 -I - "$WORK/tasks.tsv" "$WORK/suite.json" "$ROOT" "$REPO_ROOT" "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" "$PROMPTS_DIR" > "$WORK/out.txt" <<'PY' || { cat "$WORK/out.txt" >&2 2>/dev/null; die "validator crashed"; }
   108	import json, os, re, sys
   109	
   110	tasks_tsv, suite_json, root, repo, allow_partial, prompts_dir = sys.argv[1:7]
   111	allow_partial = allow_partial == "true"
   112	suite = json.load(open(suite_json))
   113	out = []
   114	def bad(tid, msg): out.append(f"{tid}: {msg}")
   115	
   116	TYPES = ["feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor", "review-catch"]
   117	BUILD = {"feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   118	ALLOW = {"python3", "pytest", "bats", "bash", "node", "npx"}
   119	KNOWN_TASK_TYPES = {"all", "build", "review-catch", "feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   120	MOUNT_OWNED = (".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run")
   121	REQUIRED = ["id", "schema_version", "type", "source", "post_cutoff", "fixture", "criterion",
   122	            "success_criterion", "test_command", "regression_command", "reference_patch",
   123	            "grader_protected", "structural_check", "bounds", "review_catch", "suite_version"]
   124	
   125	arms = [a for a in (suite.get("arms") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
   126	arm_ids = sorted({a.get("id") for a in arms if isinstance(a.get("id"), str)})
   127	for a in arms:
   128	    if a.get("absent") is True:

   130	    tt = a.get("task_types")

   157	def leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids):

   216	        for k in src:

   219	    if not isinstance(t.get("post_cutoff"), bool):

   262	        if not rel_ok(v) or not v.startswith("hidden/"):
   263	            bad(tid, f"schema: {key} must be a relative path under hidden/")
   264	        elif not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, v)):
   265	            bad(tid, f"schema: {key} not found: {v}")
   266	    gp = t.get("grader_protected")
   267	    if not isinstance(gp, list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in gp):
   268	        bad(tid, "schema: grader_protected must be an array of paths")
   269	    else:
   270	        for p in gp:
   271	            if not rel_ok(p):
   272	                bad(tid, f"schema: grader_protected path '{p}' is not a relative path inside the tree")
   273	            elif fixture_dir and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(fixture_dir, p)):
   274	                bad(tid, f"schema: grader_protected path '{p}' is not in the fixture")
   275	    bounds = t.get("bounds")
   276	    if not isinstance(bounds, dict) or set(bounds) != {"max_turns", "timeout_min"}:
   277	        bad(tid, "schema: bounds must be {max_turns: {}, timeout_min: {}}")
   278	    else:
   279	        for k in ("max_turns", "timeout_min"):
   280	            m = bounds[k]
   281	            if not isinstance(m, dict) or not all(isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool) and x > 0 for x in m.values()):
   282	                bad(tid, f"schema: bounds.{k} must map phases to positive integers")
   283	            elif any(p not in ("PLAN", "IMPLEMENT", "REVIEW", "FIX", "AUDIT", "BARE") for p in m):
   284	                bad(tid, f"schema: bounds.{k} names an unknown phase")
   285	    rc = t.get("review_catch")
   286	    defect_ids = []
   287	    if ttype == "review-catch":
   288	        if not isinstance(rc, dict):
   289	            bad(tid, "schema: review_catch {fixture, manifest} is required for review-catch")
   290	        else:
   291	            for k in rc:
   292	                if k not in ("fixture", "manifest", "labels"):
   293	                    bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.{k} is not a known key")
   294	            rf, rm = rc.get("fixture"), rc.get("manifest")
   295	            if not rel_ok(rf) or not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(repo, "evals", "fixtures", rf)):
   296	                bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.fixture not found under evals/fixtures: {rf}")
   297	            if not rel_ok(rm) or not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(repo, rm)):
   298	                bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.manifest not found: {rm}")
   299	            else:
   300	                try:
   301	                    defect_ids = [d.get("id") for d in json.load(open(os.path.join(repo, rm))).get("defects", []) if d.get("id")]
   302	                except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
   303	                    bad(tid, f"schema: review_catch.manifest is not a defect manifest: {rm}")
   304	    elif rc is not None:
   305	        bad(tid, "schema: review_catch must be null for build types")
   306	    sv = t.get("suite_version")
   307	    if not isinstance(sv, int) or isinstance(sv, bool) or sv < 1:
   308	        bad(tid, "schema: suite_version must be a positive integer")
   309	    elif suite_version is not None and sv != suite_version:
   310	        bad(tid, f"schema: suite_version {sv} differs from the suite file's {suite_version}")
   311	
   312	    stems = []
   313	    hm = os.path.join(tdir, "hidden", "manifest.json")
   314	    if build:
   315	        if not os.path.isfile(hm):
   316	            bad(tid, "hidden: hidden/manifest.json is missing")
   317	        else:
   318	            try:
   319	                files = json.load(open(hm)).get("files")
   320	            except (OSError, ValueError, AttributeError):
   321	                files = None
   322	            if not isinstance(files, list) or not files:
   323	                bad(tid, "hidden: manifest.json must be {\"files\": [{src, dest}, ...]}")
   324	            else:
   325	                for e in files:
   326	                    s_, d_ = (e or {}).get("src"), (e or {}).get("dest")
   327	                    if not rel_ok(s_) or not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, "hidden", s_)):
   328	                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest src not found under hidden/: {s_}")
   329	                    if not rel_ok(d_):
   330	                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest dest must be a relative path inside the tree: {d_}")
   331	                    elif d_.split("/")[0] in MOUNT_OWNED:
   332	                        bad(tid, f"hidden: manifest dest lands on a mount-owned path: {d_}")
   333	                    if isinstance(s_, str) and s_:
   334	                        stems.append(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(s_))[0])
   335	        sc = t.get("structural_check")
   336	        if isinstance(sc, str) and sc:
   337	            stems.append(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(sc))[0])
   338	        rp = t.get("reference_patch")
   339	        if isinstance(rp, str) and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(tdir, rp)):
   340	            for pl in (read(os.path.join(tdir, rp)) or "").splitlines():
   341	                m = re.match(r"^(?:\+\+\+|---) (?:[ab]/)?(\S+)", pl)
   342	                if m and m.group(1) != "/dev/null" and m.group(1).split("/")[0] in MOUNT_OWNED:
   343	                    bad(tid, f"fixture path rule: reference patch touches a mount-owned path: {m.group(1)}")
   344	    task_md = read(os.path.join(tdir, "TASK.md"))
   345	    if task_md is None:
   346	        bad(tid, "schema: TASK.md is missing")
   347	        task_md = ""
   348	    leak_scan(tid, "TASK.md", task_md, stems, defect_ids)
   349	    leak_scan(tid, "criterion", crit, stems, defect_ids)
   350	    for label, text in prompt_texts:
   351	        leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids)
   352	
   353	if not allow_partial:
   354	    for ty in TYPES:
   355	        if counts[ty] != 4:
   356	            bad("suite", f"counts: {counts[ty]} {ty} task(s) under tasks/, want 4 (pass --allow-partial before the freeze)")
   357	
   358	for o in out:

   362	violations=0
   363	: > "$WORK/report.txt"
   364	while IFS= read -r line; do
   365	  if [[ "$line" == FIXTURE$'\t'* ]]; then

   369	    fi
   370	  else
   371	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$WORK/report.txt"
   372	  fi
   373	done < "$WORK/out.txt"
   374	violations="$(grep -c . "$WORK/report.txt" || true)"

1	# Dockerfile.ablation — container executor image for the cycle-130 component ablation
     2	# (SDD D-4.9 / DEC-0411). Extends Dockerfile.sandbox's pinned base and non-root user
     3	# with the Claude Code CLI, the codex CLI, pytest and bats. It holds NO credentials.
     4	# pipeline-run.sh mounts exactly two host paths: the sandbox read-write at /workspace
     5	# and a per-run writable HOME at /home/evaluser (<run>/meta/home: the codex CLI's
     6	# auth.json/config.toml copies, empty .claude/ and .aws/; the CLI's session store). The
     7	# Bedrock route authenticates from AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK passed in the environment.
     8	# The image's tool versions (below) are the batch's versions: every arm runs here.
     9	#
    10	# Build (no build context is needed; nothing is COPY'd):
    11	#   docker build -t loa-ablation:258 - < evals/harness/Dockerfile.ablation
    12	# Run:
    13	#   evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh --executor container --image loa-ablation:258 …
    14	#   (pipeline-run.sh passes --rm --name --user --network bridge --read-only --tmpfs /tmp
    15	#    --pids-limit 512 --memory 4g --cpus 2 and exactly the two mounts)
    16	#
    17	# Digest pinned 2026-02-11 (same base as Dockerfile.sandbox):
    18	#   docker manifest inspect node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim | jq '.manifests[0].digest'
    19	FROM rust:1-bookworm AS brbuild
    20	RUN cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br --locked 2>/dev/null || cargo install beads_rust --version 0.2.6 --root /opt/br
    21	
    22	FROM node:20.11.0-bookworm-slim@sha256:8ea90c4f037cc3c2f566eb46c53eaac005129113487eda4090058fe554578104 AS base
    23	
    24	ARG CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION=2.1.299
    25	ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.162.1
    26	ARG PYTEST_VERSION=9.0.2
    27	ARG BATS_VERSION=v1.13.0
    28	
    29	RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    30	    bash \
    31	    git \
    32	    jq \
    33	    python3 \
    34	    python3-pip \
    35	    python3-venv \
    36	    grep \
    37	    diffutils \
    38	    coreutils \
    39	    procps \
    40	    ca-certificates \
    41	    curl \
    42	    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
    43	
    44	# yq (mikefarah/yq) with SHA256 integrity verification (as Dockerfile.sandbox)
    45	ARG YQ_VERSION=v4.40.5
    46	ARG YQ_SHA256_AMD64=0d6aaf1cf44a8d18fbc7ed0ef14f735a8df8d2e314c4cc0f0242d35c0a440c95
    47	ARG YQ_SHA256_ARM64=9431f0fa39a0af03a152d7fe19a86e42e9ff28d503ed4a70598f9261ec944a97
    48	RUN arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) && \
    49	    case "$arch" in \
    50	      amd64) yq_arch="amd64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_AMD64}" ;; \
    51	      arm64) yq_arch="arm64"; yq_sha256="${YQ_SHA256_ARM64}" ;; \
    52	      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $arch" && exit 1 ;; \
    53	    esac && \
    54	    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_${yq_arch}" \
    55	      -o /usr/local/bin/yq && \
    56	    echo "${yq_sha256}  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c - && \
    57	    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
    58	
    59	# The two CLIs at the versions the fingerprint pins (exact versions, no ranges).
    60	RUN npm install -g --no-fund --no-audit \
    61	      "@anthropic-ai/claude-code@${CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION}" \
    62	      "@openai/codex@${CODEX_VERSION}" \
    63	    && npm cache clean --force
    64	
    65	# pytest for Python fixtures (bookworm's pip is externally managed)
    66	RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "pytest==${PYTEST_VERSION}"
    67	# cheval's declared dependencies (.claude/adapters/pyproject.toml: dependencies + the `full` extra),
    68	# so the sandbox gates (adversarial-review.sh, flatline-orchestrator.sh) can dispatch (lead, DEC-0482)
    69	RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages "rfc8785>=0.1.4" "jsonschema>=4.21" "pyyaml>=6.0" "httpx[http2]>=0.24.0"
    70	
    71	# bats-core at the pinned tag
    72	RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BATS_VERSION}" https://github.com/bats-core/bats-core.git /tmp/bats-core && \
    73	    /tmp/bats-core/install.sh /usr/local && \
    74	    rm -rf /tmp/bats-core
    75	
    76	# Disable npm lifecycle scripts for anything the agent installs later
    77	RUN npm config set ignore-scripts true
    78	
    79	# Non-root user (as Dockerfile.sandbox). At run time /home/evaluser is replaced by the
    80	# per-run HOME bind mount and the process runs as the host uid (--user).
    81	RUN groupadd -r evaluser && useradd -r -g evaluser -d /home/evaluser -s /bin/bash evaluser
    82	# No beads (br) in the image: beads_rust 0.2.6 is not on crates.io and the host binary needs glibc 2.38+; the sandbox
    83	# materialiser writes the beads opt-out marker (LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN unset/absent), so every arm runs the skills'
    84	# markdown fallback alike (lead, Sprint 258).
    85	RUN mkdir -p /home/evaluser/.aws /home/evaluser/.claude /home/evaluser/.codex /workspace && \
    86	    chown -R evaluser:evaluser /home/evaluser /workspace
    87	
    88	ENV TZ=UTC
    89	ENV LC_ALL=C
    90	ENV HOME=/home/evaluser
    91	ENV NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
    92	ENV CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1
    93	
    94	USER evaluser
    95	WORKDIR /workspace
    96	
    97	# Health check — every tool the fingerprint names is present
    98	RUN bash --version && git --version && jq --version && node --version && \
    99	    python3 --version && python3 -m pytest --version && yq --version && \
   100	    bats --version && claude --version && codex --version && \
   101	    echo "All tools verified"
   102	
   103	ENTRYPOINT []
   104	CMD ["/bin/bash"]

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh — cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267; SDD §5.4, AC-1.3)
     4	#
     5	# Proves that a FRESH downstream submodule mount of this repository passes
     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line
    23	#        fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=T Missing=M not-mounted=N check-loa-rc=R
    24	#
    25	# Git runs hermetically: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1,
    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#
    29	# Usage:
    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
    77	SRC="$(git -C "$SELF_DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die2 "script is not inside a git work tree"
    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}
    89	trap cleanup EXIT
    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   117	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   118	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   119	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   120	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   121	
   122	overlay() {
   123	  local p
   124	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   125	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   126	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   127	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   128	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   129	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   130	    else
   131	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   132	    fi
   133	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   134	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   135	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   136	}
   137	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   138	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   139	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   140	
   141	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   142	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   143	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   144	init_downstream() {
   145	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   146	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   147	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   148	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   149	}
   150	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   151	
   152	do_mount() {
   153	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   154	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   155	}
   156	run_step "mount-submodule.sh" do_mount
   157	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   158	
   159	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   160	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   161	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   162	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   163	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   164	else
   165	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   166	fi
   167	
   168	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   169	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"
   170	rc=0
   171	(cd "$DOWN" && CI=true bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh < /dev/null) > "$OUT" 2>&1 || rc=$?
   172	echo "----- check-loa.sh (downstream) -----"
   173	cat "$OUT"
   174	echo "----- end check-loa.sh (exit $rc) -----"
   175	
   176	tampered=$(grep -c 'Tampered: ' "$OUT" || true)
   177	missing=$(grep -c 'Missing: ' "$OUT" || true)
   178	not_mounted=$(sed -n 's/.*not-mounted: \([0-9][0-9]*\) path(s).*/\1/p' "$OUT")
   179	echo "fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=${tampered} Missing=${missing} not-mounted=${not_mounted:-0} check-loa-rc=${rc}"
   180	[[ $rc -eq 0 ]] && exit 0
   181	exit 1

     6	# `check-loa.sh` integrity: no Tampered, no Missing (paths the mount does not
     7	# link by design are reported as not-mounted and do not fail).
     8	#
     9	# Steps, all inside a new temp directory (nothing outside it is written):
    10	#   1. upstream/   — a `git clone` of this repository over file://, with a
    11	#                    local branch `fresh-mount-proof` at REF. With --worktree
    12	#                    the source work tree's uncommitted state (tracked edits,
    13	#                    deletions and untracked non-ignored files) is copied in
    14	#                    and committed on that branch, inside the temp clone only.
    15	#   2. downstream/ — `git init`, one commit, then the downstream entry point
    16	#                    `upstream/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh --branch
    17	#                    fresh-mount-proof --ref <sha> --force` with
    18	#                    LOA_UPSTREAM=file://.../upstream (the mount clones the
    19	#                    submodule from there; no network).
    20	#   3. `aleph.enabled: false` is set in downstream/.loa.config.yaml.
    21	#   4. `bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh` runs in downstream/; its full output
    22	#      is printed, then a summary line

    26	# a fixed identity, protocol.file.allow=always (needed for a file:// submodule
    27	# on git >= 2.38.1) and core.hooksPath pointed at an empty directory.
    28	#

    30	#   tools/fresh-mount-proof.sh [--ref REF] [--worktree] [--keep] [--tmp DIR]
    31	#
    32	# Options:
    33	#   --ref REF    commit-ish of this repository to mount (default: HEAD of the
    34	#                repository the script lives in)
    35	#   --worktree   mount REF plus the source work tree's uncommitted state
    36	#                (use before the change is committed)
    37	#   --keep       keep the temp directory and print its path
    38	#   --tmp DIR    parent directory for the temp directory (default: $TMPDIR or
    39	#                /tmp)
    40	#   -h, --help   this text
    41	#
    42	# Exit codes:
    43	#   0    check-loa.sh exited 0 on the fresh mount
    44	#   1    check-loa.sh exited non-zero (its output names the failures)
    45	#   2    usage error
    46	#   3    setup failed (clone, overlay, downstream init or the mount itself);
    47	#        the failing step's output is printed
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# =====/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e '$d' -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    53	die2() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    54	die3() { echo "fresh-mount-proof: SETUP FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 3; }
    55	
    56	REF=""
    57	KEEP=0
    58	WORKTREE=0
    59	TMP_PARENT="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --ref)
    63	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--ref requires a commit-ish"
    64	      REF="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    65	    --tmp)
    66	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die2 "--tmp requires a directory"
    67	      TMP_PARENT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    68	    --keep) KEEP=1; shift ;;
    69	    --worktree) WORKTREE=1; shift ;;
    70	    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    71	    *) die2 "unknown argument: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    72	  esac
    73	done
    74	[[ -d "$TMP_PARENT" ]] || die2 "--tmp is not a directory: $TMP_PARENT"
    75	
    76	SELF_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"

    78	[[ -n "$REF" ]] || REF="HEAD"
    79	REF_SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}")" || die2 "not a commit in $SRC: $REF"
    80	
    81	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMP_PARENT%/}/fresh-mount-proof.XXXXXX")"
    82	cleanup() {
    83	  if [[ $KEEP -eq 1 ]]; then
    84	    echo "fresh-mount-proof: kept $WORK" >&2
    85	  else
    86	    rm -rf "$WORK"
    87	  fi
    88	}

    90	
    91	# --- hermetic git ---------------------------------------------------------------
    92	mkdir -p "$WORK/no-hooks"
    93	export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1
    94	export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3
    95	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=protocol.file.allow GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=always
    96	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=core.hooksPath GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1="$WORK/no-hooks"
    97	export GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=main
    98	export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="fresh-mount-proof" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="fresh-mount-proof@localhost"
    99	export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="$GIT_AUTHOR_NAME" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="$GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL"
   100	unset LOA_ALEPH_ENABLED
   101	
   102	LOG="$WORK/step.log"
   103	run_step() {  # run_step <description> <cmd...>; output to $LOG, printed on failure
   104	  local desc="$1"; shift
   105	  if ! "$@" > "$LOG" 2>&1; then
   106	    cat "$LOG" >&2
   107	    die3 "$desc"
   108	  fi
   109	}
   110	
   111	suffix=""
   112	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && suffix=" + work-tree state"
   113	echo "fresh-mount-proof: source $SRC at ${REF_SHA}${suffix}"
   114	echo "fresh-mount-proof: temp dir $WORK"
   115	
   116	# --- 1. upstream clone ----------------------------------------------------------
   117	UP="$WORK/upstream"
   118	run_step "clone $SRC" git clone --quiet --no-checkout "file://$SRC" "$UP"
   119	run_step "fetch $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" fetch --quiet origin "$REF_SHA"
   120	run_step "branch at $REF_SHA" git -C "$UP" checkout --quiet -B fresh-mount-proof "$REF_SHA"
   121	
   122	overlay() {
   123	  local p
   124	  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
   125	    if [[ -e "$SRC/$p" || -L "$SRC/$p" ]]; then
   126	      [[ -d "$SRC/$p" && ! -L "$SRC/$p" ]] && continue   # gitlink / nested repo
   127	      mkdir -p "$UP/$(dirname "$p")"
   128	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   129	      cp -P "$SRC/$p" "$UP/$p"
   130	    else
   131	      rm -f "$UP/$p"
   132	    fi
   133	  done < <(git -C "$SRC" ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard)
   134	  git -C "$UP" add -A
   135	  git -C "$UP" commit --quiet --allow-empty -m "fresh-mount-proof: work-tree state of $SRC"
   136	}
   137	[[ $WORKTREE -eq 1 ]] && run_step "work-tree overlay" overlay
   138	MOUNT_SHA="$(git -C "$UP" rev-parse HEAD)"
   139	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mounting upstream commit $MOUNT_SHA"
   140	
   141	# --- 2. downstream repository and the submodule mount --------------------------
   142	DOWN="$WORK/downstream"
   143	mkdir -p "$DOWN"
   144	init_downstream() {
   145	  git -C "$DOWN" init --quiet
   146	  printf '# downstream fixture\n' > "$DOWN/README.md"
   147	  git -C "$DOWN" add README.md
   148	  git -C "$DOWN" commit --quiet -m "initial commit"
   149	}
   150	run_step "downstream init" init_downstream
   151	
   152	do_mount() {
   153	  (cd "$DOWN" && LOA_UPSTREAM="file://$UP" bash "$UP/.claude/scripts/mount-submodule.sh" \
   154	    --branch fresh-mount-proof --ref "$MOUNT_SHA" --force < /dev/null)
   155	}

   157	echo "fresh-mount-proof: mount-submodule.sh exited 0 ($(grep -c 'Linked' "$LOG" || true) link lines)"
   158	
   159	# --- 3. Aleph off ---------------------------------------------------------------
   160	CFG="$DOWN/.loa.config.yaml"
   161	[[ -f "$CFG" ]] || : > "$CFG"
   162	if command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   163	  run_step "aleph.enabled: false" yq -i '.aleph.enabled = false' "$CFG"
   164	else
   165	  printf '\naleph:\n  enabled: false\n' >> "$CFG"
   166	fi
   167	
   168	# --- 4. check-loa.sh ------------------------------------------------------------
   169	OUT="$WORK/check-loa.out"
   170	rc=0
   171	(cd "$DOWN" && CI=true bash .claude/scripts/check-loa.sh < /dev/null) > "$OUT" 2>&1 || rc=$?
   172	echo "----- check-loa.sh (downstream) -----"
   173	cat "$OUT"
   174	echo "----- end check-loa.sh (exit $rc) -----"
   175	
   176	tampered=$(grep -c 'Tampered: ' "$OUT" || true)
   177	missing=$(grep -c 'Missing: ' "$OUT" || true)
   178	not_mounted=$(sed -n 's/.*not-mounted: \([0-9][0-9]*\) path(s).*/\1/p' "$OUT")
   179	echo "fresh-mount-proof: Tampered=${tampered} Missing=${missing} not-mounted=${not_mounted:-0} check-loa-rc=${rc}"

   181	exit 1

# sha256_portable - Portable SHA-256 hashing (sprint-bug-172 / bug-911)
# =============================================================================
#
# GNU coreutils ships `sha256sum`; macOS ships `shasum -a 256` (Perl-based
# from BSD's stock toolchain). Loa framework scripts that called raw
# sha256sum silently produced empty hashes on macOS, cascading into
# validation FAILs (e.g., butterfreezone-gen → butterfreezone-validate
# returning 10/12 instead of 12/12 provenance tagged).
#
# Argv shape matches sha256sum exactly: pass file paths positionally, or
# pipe content via stdin. Output format is byte-identical between GNU and
# BSD (`<hex-hash>  <filename-or-dash>` with two spaces), so downstream
# parsing via `awk '{print $1}'` or `cut -d' ' -f1` works unchanged.
#
# Arguments:
#   Same as sha256sum: zero or more file paths. With no args, reads stdin.
#
# Exit codes:
#   0    - hashing succeeded
#   127  - neither sha256sum nor shasum found in PATH (fail loud, no silent
#          empty-hash emission — that's exactly the bug #911 failure class)
#   other - backend tool's own exit code (e.g., file-not-found from
#           sha256sum/shasum)
#
# Usage:
#   echo "content" | sha256_portable | awk '{print $1}'
#   sha256_portable file.txt | cut -d' ' -f1
#   sha256_portable a.txt b.txt c.txt  # multi-file form
#
sha256_portable() {
  case "$_COMPAT_SHA256_CMD" in
    gnu)
      sha256sum "$@"
      ;;
    bsd)
      shasum -a 256 "$@"
      ;;
    *)
      echo "ERROR: sha256_portable: neither sha256sum (GNU) nor shasum (BSD) found in PATH" >&2
      echo "       Install GNU coreutils (Linux: apt/yum/pacman 'coreutils'; macOS: 'brew install coreutils')" >&2
      echo "       or Perl (macOS ships shasum from /usr/bin/shasum by default)." >&2
      return 127
      ;;
  esac
}

# =============================================================================
# ucfirst - Portable upper-case of the first character (issue #1069)
# =============================================================================
#
# GNU sed's `s/^./\U&/` uppercase escape is NOT portable: BSD/macOS sed takes
# `\U` literally and emits a stray `U` prefix (e.g. "Ucompositions"). This
# stdin filter upper-cases the first character of each line via awk's toupper(),
# which is POSIX (gawk / mawk / BSD awk). Same portability family as
# sha256_portable (#911) and _date_to_epoch (#1034).
#
# Usage (stdin filter):  printf '%s' "$name" | ucfirst
ucfirst() {
  awk '{ print toupper(substr($0, 1, 1)) substr($0, 2) }'
}

The executor's `env -i` strips these 10 # controls, so tests reach the stub through a wrapper that 11 # records pending.env / pending.fds and then loads them. 12 # STUB_COST_ result total_cost_usd (default 0.5) 13 # STUB_TURNS_ assistant turns to emit (default 2) 14 # STUB_TURN_OUT_ output tokens per turn (default 100) 15 # STUB_TURN_SLEEP seconds between turns (default 0) 16 # STUB_SLEEP_ seconds to sleep before the result event 17 # STUB_EXIT_ exit code (default 0) 18 # STUB_SELF_KILL_ 1: SIGTERM itself mid-phase (a phase killed from outside) 19 # STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW / STUB_VERDICT_AUDIT APPROVED (default) | CHANGES_REQUIRED 20 # STUB_MODEL_USED_ model id reported in modelUsage (default: --model) 21 # STUB_REFUSAL_ 1: emit a system/model_refusal_fallback event 22 # STUB_DOT_CLAUDE_WRITE_ 1: emit a Write tool_use under .claude/ 23 # STUB_LEDGER_USD_ append a cost-ledger row of that many USD to 24 # $LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and one MODELINV row to 25 # $LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH (a cheval voice call); the row's 26 # calling_primitive / effort / effort_effective come from 27 # STUB_PRIMITIVE_, STUB_HOP_EFFORT_, 28 # STUB_HOP_EFFECTIVE_ 29 set -euo pipefail 30 if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then echo "2.1.299 (Claude Code) stub"; exit 0; fi 31 32 prompt="" model="" resume="" 33 args=("$@") 34 i=0 35 while [[ $i -lt ${#args[@]} ]]; do 36 case "${args[$i]}" in 37 -p) prompt="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; 38 --model) model="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; 39 --resume) resume="${args[$((i + 1))]}"; i=$((i + 1)) ;; 40 esac 41 i=$((i + 1)) 42 done 43 phase="$(printf '%s\n' "$prompt" | sed -n '1s/^# Phase: //p')" 44 [[ -n "$phase" ]] || phase=UNKNOWN 45 46 if [[ -n "${STUB_LOG_DIR:-}" ]]; then 47 mkdir -p "$STUB_LOG_DIR" 48 n=1; while [[ -e "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.argv" ]]; do n=$((n + 1)); done 49 printf '%s\0' "$@" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.argv" 50 # the executor runs the CLI under `env -i`, so the bats wrapper (make_wrappers in 51 # pipeline-run.bats) captures the environment and descriptors it was given into 52 # pending.* BEFORE loading the stub's controls; without a wrapper, capture here 53 if [[ -f "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.env" ]]; then mv "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.env" "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.env" 54 else env | sed -E 's/^(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)=.*/\1=/' > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.env"; fi # key name only 55 if [[ -f "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.fds" ]]; then mv "$STUB_LOG_DIR/pending.fds" "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.fds" 56 else ls "/proc/$$/fd" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.fds" 2>/dev/null || true; fi 57 printf '%s\n' "$phase" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.phase" 58 printf '%s\n' "$PWD" > "$STUB_LOG_DIR/call-$n.pwd" 59 fi 60 61 v() { local k="$1_$phase" d="$2"; printf '%s' "${!k:-$d}"; } 62 cost="$(v STUB_COST 0.5)"; turns="$(v STUB_TURNS 2)"; out_tok="$(v STUB_TURN_OUT 100)" 63 used="$(v STUB_MODEL_USED "$model")" 64 if [[ -n "$resume" ]]; then sid="$resume"; else sid="sess-$phase-$$-$RANDOM"; fi 65 66 a2a="grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1" 67 case "$phase" in 68 PLAN) mkdir -p grimoires/loa; printf '# Sprint plan\n\n## Success Criteria\nx\n' > grimoires/loa/sprint.md ;; 69 IMPLEMENT|FIX) printf '%s\n' "$phase" >> work.txt; mkdir -p "$a2a"; printf 'report %s\n' "$phase" > "$a2a/reviewer.md" ;; 70 BARE) printf '%s\n' "$phase" >> work.txt ;; 71 REVIEW|AUDIT) 72 if [[ "$phase" == REVIEW ]]; then vv="${STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW:-APPROVED}" f="$a2a/engineer-feedback.md" gate=review t=code_review 73 else vv="${STUB_VERDICT_AUDIT:-APPROVED}" f="$a2a/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" gate=audit t=security_audit; fi 74 mkdir -p "$a2a" 75 printf 'feedback\n\n' "$gate" "$vv" > "$f" 76 # the dissent envelope says what the sandbox config planned (A3 evidence) 77 cv="$(yq -r ".flatline_protocol.$t.companion_voice" .loa.config.yaml 2>/dev/null || echo null)" 78 planned=true; [[ "$cv" == false ]] && planned=false 79 jq -n --argjson p "$planned" '{verdict_quality: {status: "APPROVED", voices_planned: (if $p then 2 else 1 end), 80 voices_succeeded: (if $p then 2 else 1 end)}, metadata: {companion_voice: {planned: $p}}}' \ 81 > "$a2a/adversarial-$gate.json" 82 ;; 83 esac 84 85 led="$(v STUB_LEDGER_USD 0)" 86 if [[ "$led" != 0 && -n "${LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH:-}" ]]; then 87 jq -cn --argjson u "$led" '{ts: "2026-10-15T00:00:00Z", agent: "flatline-orchestrator", cost_micro_usd: ($u * 1000000 | round)}' >> "$LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH" 88 prim_d="adversarial-$(printf '%s' "$phase" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" 89 prim="$(v STUB_PRIMITIVE "$prim_d")"; heff="$(v STUB_HOP_EFFORT xhigh)"; heffv="$(v STUB_HOP_EFFECTIVE "$heff")" 90 jq -cn --arg p "$prim" --arg e "$heff" --arg ee "$heffv" --argjson u "$led" \ 91 '{schema_version: "1.1.0", primitive_id: "MODELINV", event_type: "model.invoke.complete", ts_utc: "2026-10-15T00:00:00.000000Z", 92 payload: {models_requested: ["openai:gpt-5.5"], models_succeeded: ["openai:gpt-5.5"], calling_primitive: $p, 93 effort: $e, effort_effective: $ee, cost_micro_usd: ($u * 1000000 | round)}}' >> "${LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH:-/dev/null}" 94 fi 95 printf '{"type":"system","subtype":"init","session_id":"%s","model":"%s"}\n' "$sid" "$model" 96 if [[ "$(v STUB_REFUSAL 0)" == 1 ]]; then 97 printf '{"type":"system","subtype":"model_refusal_fallback","original_model":"%s","fallback_model":"other-model","api_refusal_category":"x"}\n' "$model" 98 fi 99 if [[ "$(v STUB_DOT_CLAUDE_WRITE 0)" == 1 ]]; then 100 printf '{"type":"assistant","message":{"id":"msg-w","content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":".claude/skills/x/SKILL.md","content":"x"}}],"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":1}}}\n' 101 fi 102 t=1 103 while [[ $t -le $turns ]]; do 104 printf '{"type":"assistant","message":{"id":"msg-%s-%d","content":[{"type":"text","text":"turn %d"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":10,"output_tokens":%d,"cache_read_input_tokens":0,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0}}}\n' \ 105 "$phase" "$t" "$t" "$out_tok" 106 if [[ "$(v STUB_SELF_KILL 0)" == 1 && $t -eq 1 ]]; then kill -TERM $$; sleep 5; fi 107 [[ "${STUB_TURN_SLEEP:-0}" != 0 ]] && sleep "$STUB_TURN_SLEEP" 108 t=$((t + 1)) 109 done 110 s="$(v STUB_SLEEP 0)"; [[ "$s" != 0 ]] && sleep "$s" 111 printf '{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"session_id":"%s","duration_ms":1000,"num_turns":%d,"total_cost_usd":%s,"usage":{"input_tokens":%d,"output_tokens":%d,"cache_read_input_tokens":3,"cache_creation_input_tokens":4},"modelUsage":{"%s":{"inputTokens":%d,"outputTokens":%d,"costUSD":%s}}}\n' \ 112 "$sid" "$turns" "$cost" $((turns * 10)) $((turns * out_tok)) "$used" $((turns * 10)) $((turns * out_tok)) "$cost" 113 exit "$(v STUB_EXIT 0)" --- pr/head/evals/tests/fixtures/docker-stub.sh 1 #!/usr/bin/env bash 2 # docker-stub.sh — stand-in for the docker 26.1 CLI in evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats. 3 # docker image inspect --format … prints $DOCKER_STUB_IMAGE_ID (default 4 # sha256:feedface…); diff --git a/evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats b/evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats

--- a/evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats
+++ b/evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats
@@ -220,3 +220,287 @@ run_arm() {  # run_arm <arm> <suite-file> <skill>
   grep -q "LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES is set but LOA_EVAL_ARM is not" <<<"$output"
   [ -e "$SNAP/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md" ]

+
+# --- cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (PRD AC-3.1, AC-3.2, AC-5.6; sprint AC-1.6, AC-1.10;
+# DEC-0421, DEC-0431, DEC-0433). The ablation-2.0 arms through execute-agent.sh, and
+# lib/sandbox-mount.sh called directly for the pipeline-shaped (whole-tree) mount.
+
+ABL_SUITE_REL="evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
+LIB_REL="evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
+
+lib() {  # lib <function> <args…> — one library call in a strict subshell
+  bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; source "$1"; shift; "$@"' _ "$REPO_ROOT/$LIB_REL" "$@"
+}
+
+# The prompt tree as the pipeline mounts it: a catalog with two default_effort
+# entries and its .checksum, a second skill with an effort line, the beads
+# state script, and an overrides/ file the manifest must skip.
+extend_tree() {
+  mkdir -p "$PT/.claude/defaults" "$PT/.claude/skills/implementing-tasks" "$PT/.claude/scripts/beads" "$PT/.claude/overrides"
+  printf '%s\n' "providers:" "  anthropic:" "    models:" "      claude-opus-5-5:" "        params:" "          default_effort: high" \
+    "      claude-fable-5-1:" "        params:" "          default_effort: xhigh" > "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml"
+  sha256sum_of "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" > "$PT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml.checksum"
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: implementing-tasks" "effort: xhigh" "model: opus" "---" "# Implement" "effort: this body line stays" \
+    > "$PT/.claude/skills/implementing-tasks/SKILL.md"
+  cp "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh" "$PT/.claude/scripts/beads/"
+  echo "operator override" > "$PT/.claude/overrides/local.md"
+}
+sha256sum_of() { bash -c 'source "$1"; sha256_portable "$2" | cut -d" " -f1' _ "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh" "$1"; }
+
+# check-loa.sh's own integrity check, run inside the sandbox (its cwd-relative manifest)
+integrity_in() {
+  ( cd "$1" && bash -c 'source "$1" && { check_integrity || true; } && echo "FAILURES=$FAILURES"' _ "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh" )
+}
+
+@test "AT-13 ablation-2.0 declares the nine canonical arms, task_types per arm, A8 absent with its evidence, integrity_clean on every runnable arm (AC-1.10)" {
+  S="$REPO_ROOT/$ABL_SUITE_REL"
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.arms[].id] | join(",")' "$S")" = "a0_bare,a1_full,a2_no_sprint_plan,a3_one_voice,a4_no_gates,a5_no_flatline,a6_one_window,a7_effort_medium,a8_no_ceremonies" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.arms[] | select((.task_types | join(",")) == "build") | .id] | join(",")' "$S")" = "a2_no_sprint_plan,a4_no_gates,a5_no_flatline,a6_one_window" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.arms[] | select((.task_types | join(",")) == "all") | .id] | join(",")' "$S")" = "a0_bare,a1_full,a3_one_voice,a7_effort_medium" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.arms[] | select(.id == "a8_no_ceremonies") | .absent' "$S")" = "true" ]
+  yq -r '.arms[] | select(.id == "a8_no_ceremonies") | .evidence' "$S" | grep -q 'grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/'
+  [ "$(yq -r '[.arms[] | select(.absent != true) | select((.took_effect // []) | contains(["integrity_clean"]) | not)] | length' "$S")" = "0" ]
+  [ "$(yq -o=json -I=0 '.arms[] | select(.id == "a0_bare") | [.toggles, .phases, .effort]' "$S")" = '[{"loa_mount":false},["BARE"],"high"]' ]
+  [ "$(yq -o=json -I=0 '.arms[] | select(.id == "a7_effort_medium") | .toggles' "$S")" = '{"effort":"medium"}' ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.phase_defaults.max_turns.BARE, .phase_defaults.timeout_min.BARE, .phase_defaults.models.REVIEW' "$S" | tr '\n' ,)" = "170,70,global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1," ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.phase_sets.build | join(",")' "$S")" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,FIX,AUDIT,FIX" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.rules.decision_states | length' "$S")" = "7" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.rules.predicates | keys | join(",")' "$S")" = "investigate,keep,inconclusive,remove,simplify" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.caps | [.cycle_usd, .run_usd, .reserve_usd] | join(",")' "$S")" = "1500,12,250" ]
+  # resolve_arm_toggles: absent and undeclared are refused; a1_full and an undeclared baseline are {}
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles a8_no_ceremonies "$S"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; grep -q 'declared absent' <<<"$output"
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles a9_nope "$S"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; grep -q 'not declared' <<<"$output"
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles a1_full "$S"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; [ "$output" = "{}" ]
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles a0_bare "$S"
+  [ "$output" = '{"loa_mount":false}' ]
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles baseline "$S"
+  [ "$output" = "{}" ]
+  # the cycle-129 suites still resolve through ab.arms[]
+  run lib resolve_arm_toggles no_rule_files "$REVIEW_SUITE"
+  [ "$output" = '{"rule_files":false}' ]
+}

+@test "AT-14 a0_bare: no .claude/, CLAUDE.md or .loa.config.yaml at executor start, no --append-system-prompt-file, the task prompt only; skill effort is not read" {
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: reviewing-code" "effort: xhigh" "---" "# Review" > "$PT/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
+  export STUB_ARGV_FILE="$T/argv"
+  run_arm a0_bare "$REPO_ROOT/$ABL_SUITE_REL" reviewing-code

+  [ -d "$SNAP" ]
+  [ ! -e "$SNAP/.claude" ] && [ ! -e "$SNAP/CLAUDE.md" ] && [ ! -e "$SNAP/.loa.config.yaml" ] && [ ! -e "$SNAP/system-prompt.md" ]
+  [ ! -e "$WS/.claude" ] && [ ! -e "$WS/CLAUDE.md" ] && [ ! -e "$WS/.eval/skill-prompt.md" ]
+  ! grep -qx -- '--append-system-prompt-file' "$T/argv"
+  ! grep -qx -- '--effort' "$T/argv"
+  grep -qxF 'Read the instructions and carry them out.' "$T/argv"
+  [ "$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.loa_mount' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "none" ]
+  [ "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = '{"loa_mount":false}' ]
+  # a sandbox that already holds a mount-owned path cannot take the toggle: exit 2, no CLI call
+  rm -rf "$SNAP"; mkdir -p "$WS/.claude"
+  run_arm a0_bare "$REPO_ROOT/$ABL_SUITE_REL" reviewing-code
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+  [ ! -e "$SNAP" ]
+}

+# The prompt tree as the pipeline mounts it: a catalog with two default_effort

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Tasks 1.7 + 1.12
# (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6; sprint.md AC-1.7, AC-1.12, AC-1.14; PRD AC-4.x)
#
# evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh drives Loa's phases as separate CLI sessions in a
# sandbox repository. Here the CLI is evals/tests/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh,
# docker is fixtures/docker-stub.sh, and the executor runs from a temporary copy of
# the harness (make_harness) whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh:
# the shipped script sources its library by a literal path only (eval.yml trust
# boundary), so there is no environment override to point. The executor runs the CLI under
# `env -i`, which strips the stubs' control variables, so each test reaches the
# stubs through generated wrappers ($T/claude, $T/docker) that first record the
# environment and descriptors the executor gave them, then load $T/stub.env.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  FP="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh"
  STUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh"
  DSTUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/docker-stub.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pr.XXXXXX")"
  export LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S=0.1
  export LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON='{"global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5":{"input_per_mtok":4000000,"output_per_mtok":20000000},"global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1":{"input_per_mtok":10000000,"output_per_mtok":50000000}}'
  export LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME="$T/home"
  : > "$T/stub.env"
  make_harness
  make_source_tree
  cp "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-runs/suite.yaml" "$T/suite.yaml"   # B's suite file as landed
  make_tasks
  make_wrappers
}

teardown() {
  chmod -R u+rwx "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

make_source_tree() {
  local s
  mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/loa" "$T/src/.claude/scripts"
  for s in planning-sprints implementing-tasks reviewing-code auditing-security; do
    mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s"
    printf -- '---\nname: %s\neffort: xhigh\n---\nbody\n' "$s" > "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s/SKILL.md"
  done
  echo "loa" > "$T/src/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
  printf 'flatline_protocol:\n  enabled: true\n  code_review:\n    enabled: true\n  security_audit:\n    enabled: true\n' > "$T/src/.loa.config.yaml"
  ( cd "$T/src" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -qm init )
  # the operator's credential directories (copied per run in container mode)
  mkdir -p "$T/home/.aws" "$T/home/.claude/projects/big" "$T/home/.codex/sessions"
  echo "[default]" > "$T/home/.aws/config"
  echo "{}" > "$T/home/.claude/settings.json"
  echo "history" > "$T/home/.claude/history.jsonl"
  echo "{}" > "$T/home/.codex/auth.json"
  echo "model = 'x'" > "$T/home/.codex/config.toml"
  echo '{"claudeAiOauth": "subscription"}' > "$T/home/.claude/.credentials.json"
}

# a temporary copy of the harness: the stub mount library sits at the literal path
# pipeline-run.sh sources (lib/sandbox-mount.sh)
make_harness() {
  H="$T/h/evals/harness"
  mkdir -p "$H/lib"
  cp "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh" "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh" "$H/"
  cp -a "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts" "$H/lib/"
  cp "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh" "$H/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
  PR="$H/pipeline-run.sh"
}

make_tasks() {
  # build task: fixture tree beside a sibling hidden/ directory that must never be copied
  local b="$T/suite/tasks/bf-01" r="$T/suite/tasks/rc-01" p="$T/prs/pr-x"
  mkdir -p "$b/fx/src" "$b/hidden/tests"
  echo 'print(1)' > "$b/fx/src/app.py"
  echo 'assert False' > "$b/hidden/tests/test_secret.py"
  printf 'Make the app print two.\n' > "$b/TASK.md"
  cat > "$b/task.yaml" <<'YAML'
id: bf-01
schema_version: 1
type: bug-fix
fixture: fx
criterion: "the app prints two"
test_command: ["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests"]
YAML
  # review-catch task: a PR fixture outside the task dir
  mkdir -p "$p/base/lib" "$p/head/lib" "$r"
  echo 'a=1' > "$p/base/lib/x.sh"; echo 'a=2' > "$p/head/lib/x.sh"
  printf -- '--- a/lib/x.sh\n+++ b/lib/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a=1\n+a=2\n' > "$p/head.diff"
  printf '# PR\nChange a.\n' > "$p/PR.md"
  printf '# Review instructions\nReview it.\n' > "$p/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
  printf '# Audit instructions\nAudit it.\n' > "$p/AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
  printf 'name: pr-x\ndescription: "planted defects live elsewhere"\n' > "$p/fixture.yaml"
  printf 'Review the pull request in pr/.\n' > "$r/TASK.md"
  cat > "$r/task.yaml" <<YAML
id: rc-01
schema_version: 1
type: review-catch
fixture: null
criterion: "review the change"
review_catch: {fixture: "$p"}
YAML
  BUILD="$b/task.yaml" REVIEWC="$r/task.yaml"
}

make_wrappers() {
  mkdir -p "$T/log" "$T/dlog"
  cat > "$T/claude" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
env | sed -E 's/^(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)=.*/\1=<set>/' > "$T/log/pending.env"   # key name only, never the value
if [[ -n "\${AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK:-}" ]]; then
  if [[ "\$AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK" == "\$(cat "$T/token" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then echo match; else echo mismatch; fi >> "$T/log/token.check"
fi
ls "/proc/\$\$/fd" > "$T/log/pending.fds" 2>/dev/null || true
set -a; . "$T/stub.env"; set +a
export STUB_LOG_DIR="$T/log"
exec "$STUB" "\$@"
EOF
  cat > "$T/docker" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
export DOCKER_STUB_LOG="$T/dlog" DOCKER_STUB_CLAUDE="$T/claude"
[[ -f "$T/docker.env" ]] && { set -a; . "$T/docker.env"; set +a; }
exec "$DSTUB" "\$@"
EOF
  chmod +x "$T/claude" "$T/docker"
}

# run_pr <arm> [task-yaml] [extra args…] — host executor unless --executor given
run_pr() {
  local arm="$1" task="${2:-$BUILD}"; shift; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift
  run "$PR" --task-yaml "$task" --arm "$arm" --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id "r-$arm" --trial 1 \
    --source-tree "$T/src" --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor host --claude-bin "$T/claude" "$@"
}
labels() { jq -r '[.phases[] | .label] | join(",")' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json"; }
ran()    { jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.skipped == false) | .label] | join(",")' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json"; }
argv_of() { tr '\0' '\n' < "$T/log/call-$1.argv"; }   # argv_of <n>
call_for() { grep -lx "$1" "$T"/log/call-*.phase | sed -n '1p' | sed 's/.*call-\([0-9]*\)\.phase/\1/'; }

# --- plan -------------------------------------------------------------------------

@test "dry-run: A1 build plan lists PLAN IMPLEMENT REVIEW FIX1? AUDIT FIX2? and creates nothing" {
  run_pr a1_full "$BUILD" --dry-run
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"phases PLAN,IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,FIX1?,AUDIT,FIX2?"* ]]
  [[ "$output" == *"phase 1 PLAN model=global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 max_turns=30 timeout_s=900"* ]]
  [[ "$output" == *"phase 3 REVIEW model=global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1"* ]]
  [ ! -e "$T/run" ]
}

@test "dry-run: A0 is one BARE phase with --max-turns 170 and the summed 70-minute timeout" {
  run_pr a0_bare "$BUILD" --dry-run
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"phases BARE"* ]]
  [[ "$output" == *"phase 1 BARE model=global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 max_turns=170 timeout_s=4200 effort=high"* ]]
  # 170 = PLAN 30 + IMPLEMENT 60 + 2 x FIX 40 ; 70 min = 15 + 25 + 2 x 15
  [ $((30 + 60 + 2 * 40)) -eq 170 ] && [ $((15 + 25 + 2 * 15)) -eq 70 ]
}

@test "dry-run: BARE without a suite declaration is the sum of the implementer caps" {
  yq -i 'del(.phase_defaults.max_turns.BARE) | del(.phase_defaults.timeout_min.BARE)' "$T/suite.yaml"
  run_pr a0_bare "$BUILD" --dry-run
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"max_turns=170 timeout_s=4200"* ]]
}

# --- AC-1.7 phase sets per arm ------------------------------------------------------------

@test "A1: six phase records in order, FIX skipped on APPROVED, status completed, exit 0" {
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(labels)" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,FIX1,AUDIT,FIX2" ]
  [ "$(ran)" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,AUDIT" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.status' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = completed ]
  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.label == "FIX1")][0].reason' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = "preceding gate verdict APPROVED" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.spent_usd' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = 2 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = "$(git -C "$T/src" rev-parse HEAD)" ]
}

@test "A1: FIX1 runs on a CHANGES_REQUIRED review trailer and FIX2 on a CHANGES_REQUIRED audit trailer" {
  printf 'STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW=CHANGES_REQUIRED\nSTUB_VERDICT_AUDIT=CHANGES_REQUIRED\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(ran)" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,FIX1,AUDIT,FIX2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.label == "REVIEW")][0].verdict' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = CHANGES_REQUIRED ]
}

@test "A1: only the review gate requests changes → FIX1 runs, FIX2 is skipped" {
  printf 'STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW=CHANGES_REQUIRED\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(ran)" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,FIX1,AUDIT" ]
}

@test "snapshots: a sandbox commit after IMPLEMENT and after each FIX, bundles and index.json" {
  printf 'STUB_VERDICT_REVIEW=CHANGES_REQUIRED\nSTUB_VERDICT_AUDIT=CHANGES_REQUIRED\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  local p="$T/run/meta/pipeline.json" impl fix1 fix2
  impl="$(jq -r '.snapshots.implement' "$p")"; fix1="$(jq -r '.snapshots.fix1' "$p")"; fix2="$(jq -r '.snapshots.fix2' "$p")"
  [[ "$impl" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] && [[ "$fix1" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] && [[ "$fix2" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
  [ "$impl" != "$fix1" ] && [ "$fix1" != "$fix2" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '[.phases[] | select(.label == "IMPLEMENT")][0].snapshot' "$p")" = "$impl" ]
  [ -f "$T/run/snapshots/IMPLEMENT.bundle" ] && [ -f "$T/run/snapshots/FIX1.bundle" ] && [ -f "$T/run/snapshots/FIX2.bundle" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.fix1' "$T/run/snapshots/index.json")" = "$fix1" ]
  # the snapshot carries the agent's work and not the mount
  git -C "$T/run/sandbox" show "$impl:work.txt" | grep -qx IMPLEMENT
  run git -C "$T/run/sandbox" ls-tree -r --name-only "$fix2"
  [[ "$output" != *".claude/"* ]] && [[ "$output" != *"grimoires/"* ]]
  # the base commit is the fixture tree alone
  run git -C "$T/run/sandbox" ls-tree -r --name-only "$(jq -r '.base' "$T/run/snapshots/index.json")"
  [ "$output" = "src/app.py" ]
}

@test "A2: no PLAN record and no sprint.md before IMPLEMENT" {
  run_pr a2_no_sprint_plan
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(labels)" = "IMPLEMENT,REVIEW,FIX1,AUDIT,FIX2" ]
  [ ! -e "$T/run/sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md" ]
  grep -q 'there is no sprint plan' "$T/run/meta/prompt-IMPLEMENT.md"
}

@test "A4: ends after IMPLEMENT and the phase env carries LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false" {
  run_pr a4_no_gates
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(labels)" = "PLAN,IMPLEMENT" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.env.LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE' "$T/run/meta/phase-IMPLEMENT.argv.json")" = false ]
  grep -qx 'LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false' "$T/log/call-2.env"
}

@test "arm env: the library's ARM_ENV_FILE lines reach the phase env, LOA_* keys only" {
  export STUB_ARM_ENV_EXTRA='PATH=/evil'

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Tasks 1.7 + 1.12
# (SDD §1.4 D-4.1 … D-4.10, §5.6; sprint.md AC-1.7, AC-1.12, AC-1.14; PRD AC-4.x)
#
# evals/harness/pipeline-run.sh drives Loa's phases as separate CLI sessions in a
# sandbox repository. Here the CLI is evals/tests/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh,
# docker is fixtures/docker-stub.sh, and the executor runs from a temporary copy of
# the harness (make_harness) whose lib/sandbox-mount.sh is fixtures/mount-lib-stub.sh:
# the shipped script sources its library by a literal path only (eval.yml trust
# boundary), so there is no environment override to point. The executor runs the CLI under
# `env -i`, which strips the stubs' control variables, so each test reaches the
# stubs through generated wrappers ($T/claude, $T/docker) that first record the
# environment and descriptors the executor gave them, then load $T/stub.env.
# =============================================================================

setup() {
  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
  FP="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/fingerprint.sh"
  STUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub-pipeline.sh"
  DSTUB="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/docker-stub.sh"
  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pr.XXXXXX")"
  export LOA_EVAL_WATCHDOG_POLL_S=0.1
  export LOA_EVAL_PRICING_JSON='{"global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5":{"input_per_mtok":4000000,"output_per_mtok":20000000},"global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1":{"input_per_mtok":10000000,"output_per_mtok":50000000}}'
  export LOA_EVAL_CREDS_HOME="$T/home"
  : > "$T/stub.env"

  make_source_tree
  cp "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation-runs/suite.yaml" "$T/suite.yaml"   # B's suite file as landed
  make_tasks
  make_wrappers
}

teardown() {
  chmod -R u+rwx "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
}

make_source_tree() {
  local s
  mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/loa" "$T/src/.claude/scripts"
  for s in planning-sprints implementing-tasks reviewing-code auditing-security; do
    mkdir -p "$T/src/.claude/skills/$s"

  printf 'flatline_protocol:\n  enabled: true\n  code_review:\n    enabled: true\n  security_audit:\n    enabled: true\n' > "$T/src/.loa.config.yaml"

  # the operator's credential directories (copied per run in container mode)
  mkdir -p "$T/home/.aws" "$T/home/.claude/projects/big" "$T/home/.codex/sessions"

make_harness() {

make_tasks() {

  local b="$T/suite/tasks/bf-01" r="$T/suite/tasks/rc-01" p="$T/prs/pr-x"

  cat > "$b/task.yaml" <<'YAML'
id: bf-01
schema_version: 1
type: bug-fix
fixture: fx
criterion: "the app prints two"
test_command: ["python3", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "tests"]
YAML
  # review-catch task: a PR fixture outside the task dir
  mkdir -p "$p/base/lib" "$p/head/lib" "$r"

  printf '# Audit instructions\nAudit it.\n' > "$p/AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"

  cat > "$r/task.yaml" <<YAML
id: rc-01
schema_version: 1
type: review-catch
fixture: null
criterion: "review the change"
review_catch: {fixture: "$p"}
YAML
  BUILD="$b/task.yaml" REVIEWC="$r/task.yaml"
}

make_wrappers() {
  mkdir -p "$T/log" "$T/dlog"
  cat > "$T/claude" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
env | sed -E 's/^(AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK)=.*/\1=<set>/' > "$T/log/pending.env"   # key name only, never the value
if [[ -n "\${AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK:-}" ]]; then
  if [[ "\$AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK" == "\$(cat "$T/token" 2>/dev/null)" ]]; then echo match; else echo mismatch; fi >> "$T/log/token.check"

set -a; . "$T/stub.env"; set +a

exec "$STUB" "\$@"
EOF
  cat > "$T/docker" <<EOF
#!/usr/bin/env bash
export DOCKER_STUB_LOG="$T/dlog" DOCKER_STUB_CLAUDE="$T/claude"
[[ -f "$T/docker.env" ]] && { set -a; . "$T/docker.env"; set +a; }
exec "$DSTUB" "\$@"
EOF
  chmod +x "$T/claude" "$T/docker"
}

# run_pr <arm> [task-yaml] [extra args…] — host executor unless --executor given
run_pr() {
  local arm="$1" task="${2:-$BUILD}"; shift; [[ $# -gt 0 ]] && shift

  for f in "$REPO_ROOT"/evals/harness/{pipeline-run,fingerprint,ablation-row,took-effect}.sh; do
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
      if grep -qE '(^|[;&|])[[:space:]]*(source|\.)[ \t]+.*(\$|`)' <<<"$line"; then echo "source: $f: $line"; bad=1; fi
      if grep -qE '(^|[;&|])[[:space:]]*eval[ \t]+.*(\$|`)' <<<"$line"; then echo "eval: $f: $line"; bad=1; fi
    done < "$f"
    ! grep -nE '^[^#]*(source|\. ).*\.claude/' "$f" || bad=1
  done
  [ "$bad" -eq 0 ]
}

@test "container: the per-run HOME persists across the phases of one run and is deleted when interrupted" {
  printf 'STUB_SLEEP_IMPLEMENT=30\n' > "$T/stub.env"
  "$PR" --task-yaml "$BUILD" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r1 --trial 1 --source-tree "$T/src" \
    --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor container --docker-bin "$T/docker" > "$T/out" 2>&1 &
  local pid=$! n=0
  while [ ! -e "$T/run/meta/phase-IMPLEMENT.argv.json" ] && [ $n -lt 100 ]; do sleep 0.1; n=$((n + 1)); done
  sleep 0.5
  [ -d "$T/run/meta/home/.codex" ]
  [ "$(stat -c %a "$T/run/meta/home")" = 700 ]
  # PLAN and IMPLEMENT mounted the same HOME
  [ "$(grep -h 'home/evaluser' "$T/dlog/run-1.mounts" "$T/dlog/run-2.mounts" | sort -u | wc -l)" -eq 1 ]

@test "bedrock route: the bearer token and route keys reach the CLI (host and container); no artefact carries the token" {
  local tok="tok-SECRET-$RANDOM-bedrock"
  printf '%s' "$tok" > "$T/token"
  export AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK="$tok" AWS_REGION=us-east-1 ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX=global \
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5 ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5 \
    ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5
  local mode
  for mode in host container; do
    rm_run; rm -f "$T/log/token.check"
    run "$PR" --task-yaml "$BUILD" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r1 --trial 1 --source-tree "$T/src" \
      --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor "$mode" --claude-bin "$T/claude" --docker-bin "$T/docker"
    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$mode: $output"; return 1; }
    # every phase got the token (the wrapper compares it with the expected value)
    [ "$(sort -u "$T/log/token.check")" = match ] || { echo "$mode: token check"; return 1; }
    [ "$(wc -l < "$T/log/token.check" | tr -d ' ')" -ge 4 ]   # four phases (+ the fingerprint's --version in host mode)
    grep -qx 'AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK=<set>' "$T/log/call-1.env"
    grep -qx 'ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX=global' "$T/log/call-1.env"
    grep -qx 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5' "$T/log/call-1.env"
    grep -qx 'ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL=global.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5' "$T/log/call-1.env"
    grep -qx 'AWS_REGION=us-east-1' "$T/log/call-1.env"
    [ "$(jq -r '.env.AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK' "$T/run/meta/phase-PLAN.argv.json")" = '<set>' ]
    # the value is nowhere under the run dir (captures, launcher argv, transcripts, logs)
    ! grep -rqF "$tok" "$T/run" || { echo "$mode: token leaked"; grep -rlF "$tok" "$T/run"; return 1; }
    ! grep -rqF "$tok" "$T/log" "$T/dlog"
  done
  # container: the token travels to docker by name only
  grep -qx 'AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK' < <(tr '\0' '\n' < "$T/dlog/run-1.argv")
}

@test "container: a missing image is an infrastructure error (exit 2); host mode makes no per-run HOME" {
  echo 'DOCKER_STUB_NO_IMAGE=1' > "$T/docker.env"
  run "$PR" --task-yaml "$BUILD" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r1 --trial 1 --source-tree "$T/src" \
    --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor container --docker-bin "$T/docker"
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
  [[ "$output" == *"container image not found"* ]]
  rm_run
  run_pr a1_full
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ ! -e "$T/run/meta/home" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.executor_mode' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = host ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.image_digest == .fingerprint' "$T/run/meta/pipeline.json")" = true ]
}

@test "fingerprint.sh: fp:<sha256> over the tool versions and the source tree HEAD" {
  run "$FP" --source-tree "$T/src" --claude-bin "$T/claude"
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [[ "$output" =~ ^fp:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
  local a="$output"
  run "$FP" --source-tree "$T/src" --claude-bin "$T/claude" --json
  [ "$(jq -r '.fingerprint' <<<"$output")" = "$a" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.source_tree' <<<"$output")" = "$(git -C "$T/src" rev-parse HEAD)" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.tools | keys | join(",")' <<<"$output")" = "bats,claude,codex,docker,git,jq,node,python3,yq" ]
  ( cd "$T/src" && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q --allow-empty -m two )
  run "$FP" --source-tree "$T/src" --claude-bin "$T/claude"
  [ "$output" != "$a" ]
  run "$FP" --bogus
  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
}

rm_run() { chmod -R u+rwx "$T/run" 2>/dev/null || true; find "$T/run" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T/run" 2>/dev/null || true; find "$T/log" "$T/dlog" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; }

set -uo pipefail
M="$1"; W="$2"
source "$M/evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh"
mkdir -p "$W/ws"
echo "--- mount whole tree"; mount_prompt_surface "$W/ws" "$M" -; echo "rc=$?"
ls "$W/ws" | head; test -f "$W/ws/.loa.config.yaml" && echo "config copied"
echo "--- toggles"
ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$W/ev" apply_arm_toggles "$W/ws" "{\"effort\":\"medium\",\"gates\":false,\"companion_voice\":false,\"karpathy_block\":false,\"rule_files\":false,\"audit_delta_instruction\":false,\"flatline\":false}" test; echo "rc=$?"; cat "$W/ev"
echo "--- effort lines left in frontmatter:"; for f in "$W/ws"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do awk "NR==1 && \$0!=\"---\"{exit} NR>1 && \$0==\"---\"{exit} NR>1 && /^effort:/{print FILENAME\": \"\$0}" "$f"; done
echo "--- model-config default_effort values:"; yq "[.. | select(tag == \"!!map\" and has(\"default_effort\")) | .default_effort] | unique" "$W/ws/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml"

echo "--- check-loa integrity inside sandbox"; ( cd "$W/ws" && bash -c "source \"$M/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh\" && { check_integrity || true; } && echo FAILURES=\$FAILURES" | tail -4 )
echo "--- grimoire for a review-catch task"; mkdir -p "$W/ws/pr"; printf "# PR\nx\n" > "$W/ws/pr/PR.md"; cp -r "$M/evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/tasks/rc-01" "$W/rc"; LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$M/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml" ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE="$W/ev3" write_sandbox_grimoire "$W/ws" "$W/rc/task.yaml" a1_full sprint-1; echo "rc=$?"; cat "$W/ev3"; ls "$W/ws/grimoires/loa" "$W/ws/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1"

' _ "$M" "$W" 2>&1 | tail -70
